title: Swarm Event
description: Notifier payload emitted by the transition composite action and consumed by notify adapters. Per SPEC §2.4.

role.description: Agent role that produced this event (e.g. validator, developer, reviewer). Optional; populated at outcome-producing call sites.

verdict.description: Outcome verdict string (e.g. confirmed, approved, blocked). Optional; populated when the agent stage has a validated outcome.

evidence.description: Ordered list of concrete evidence bullets supporting the verdict. Optional; each item is a single-line string (newlines stripped by callers).
